### IQVIA Selects Veeva Clinical Operations Applications


October 13, 2026


RESEARCH TRIANGLE PARK, N.C. and PLEASANTON, Calif.


, Oct. 13, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- IQVIA (NYSE: IQV) and[Veeva Systems](https://www.veeva.com/) (NYSE: VEEV) today announced an expansion of their partnership with the selection of Veeva CTMS, eTMF, Study Startup, and Site Connect as enterprise standard applications that will be used across IQVIA clinical development studies. This extends the previously announced EDC partnership.


Together, IQVIA and Veeva bring best-in-class capabilities to clinical research to help customers increase trial speed and efficiency, strengthen site centricity, and make better-informed decisions, ultimately helping get life-changing treatments to patients faster. All[Veeva clinical solutions](https://www.veeva.com/products/veeva-clinical-platform/) are also available through IQVIA for sponsors who wish to enable a full Veeva technology stack.


"By bringing our companies' strengths together, we're giving clinical teams a more connected way to work, built on frictionless integration of our respective technologies," said Richard Staub, president of Research and Development Solutions at IQVIA. "Just as importantly, customers retain the flexibility to choose the EDC, RTSM, and eCOA technologies and solutions that best meet their needs, including IQVIA's innovative capabilities."


"This is an exciting expansion of the partnership IQVIA and Veeva announced last year and the work we have done together since," said Veeva founder and CEO Peter Gassner. "We are committed to supporting seamless product and services integration for the benefit of our customers and improving access to innovations for patients."


Join us at[Veeva R&D and Quality Summit](https://www.veeva.com/events/rd-summit/) on October 20-21 in Boston to learn more.


**About IQVIA** IQVIA (NYSE:IQV) is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. IQVIA's portfolio of solutions are powered by IQVIA Connected Intelligence™ to deliver actionable insights and services built on high-quality health data, Healthcare-grade AI®, advanced analytics, the latest technologies and extensive domain expertise. IQVIA is committed to using AI responsibly, with AI-powered capabilities built on best-in-class approaches to privacy, regulatory compliance and patient safety, and delivering AI to the high standards of trust, scalability and precision demanded by the industry. With approximately 94,000 employees in over 100 countries, including experts in healthcare, life sciences, data science, technology and operational excellence, IQVIA is dedicated to accelerating the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide.


IQVIA is a global leader in protecting individual patient privacy. The company uses a wide variety of privacy-enhancing technologies and safeguards to protect individual privacy while generating and analyzing information on a scale that helps healthcare stakeholders identify disease patterns and correlate with the precise treatment path and therapy needed for better outcomes. IQVIA's insights and execution capabilities help biotech, medical device and pharmaceutical companies, medical researchers, government agencies, payers and other healthcare stakeholders tap into a deeper understanding of diseases, human behaviors and scientific advances, in an effort to advance their path toward cures. To learn more, visit[www.iqvia.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.iqvia.com&esheet=54211044&newsitemid=20250220975332&lan=en-US&anchor=www.iqvia.com&index=2&md5=d3c844d0222c3cd05c2d9498f31bf6c0) .


**About Veeva Systems** Veeva delivers the industry cloud for life sciences with applications, agents, data, and consulting. Committed to innovation, product excellence, and customer success, Veeva serves more than 1,500 customers, ranging from the world's largest pharmaceutical companies to emerging biotechs. As a[Public Benefit Corporation](https://www.veeva.com/pbc/) , Veeva is committed to balancing the interests of all stakeholders, including customers, employees, shareholders, and the industries it serves. For more information, visit[veeva.com](http://veeva.com/) .
